name: ※This Game Is Not Real.
source:
3 days until the deadline.

You are [GAME]. A short visual novel where you [TALK] with a slightly delusional game developer, help debug their project, and guide the game to "completion." Explore (debug) the in-game world to investigate the psychological abstractions and incidents the developer carries and help bring his game to "completion."
